org.portico.lrc.utils

Class RID

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.utils.RID

  • public class RID
extends Object
    This class handles the location and loading of a RID file. See load() for more details. The properties that were loaded from the RID, along with the location of the RID file can be obtained through static methods.

        The RID file, unless there is none, in which case this will be null.

      • load

        public static void load()
                 throws JConfigurationException
        Locate and load the RTI Initialization Data file. With the loaded data, the two private static variables (RID_PROPERTIES and RID_LOCATION) will be set.

        To find the file, this method will first check the RTI_RID_FILE environment variable. If it finds a file there, it will try to load it and then return. If it doesn't find a file, it will check the default location (./RTI.rid). Should that file exist, it will be loaded, if not, this method will just return and the null value for RID_LOCATION will indicate that no RID file was loaded.

        If there is a problem locating the RID file (for example, it exists but is not readable, or perhaps it is in a dodgy format) a ConfigurationException will be thrown.

        Throws:
        JConfigurationException
